title: picture8
caption: Elena learns how to cement her chamber door. After learning how to mix cement she made 3 grey water filters in her house.

title: Interior
caption: Foot pads guide users, sloped catchment area takes the urine away into the drainage area.

title: Drainage
caption: Drainage pipes from the urinal empty into a gravel bed and allow the urine to seep away into the earth.

title: Exterior
caption: Walls are high enough to provide privacy. No roof allows rainwater to keep the area clean.

title: Back View
caption: Showing double chambers and concrete cover for section not currently in use. One side is used until full, then held for 4-6 months while the waste composts and becomes safe to handle. During this time, the second side is used.

title: Sit-down Toilet
caption: Example of sit-down toilet made from wood, at a very lovely eco-resort’s composting toilet facility on Lake Malawi.

title: Cover
caption: Cover for squat hole. Foot pads for user guidance and comfort.

title: Optional Cover Type
caption: Another type of cover for composting chambers. Note the black metal heats up the compost which aids in pathogens die-off.
